prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1269; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine, we'll note that you've declined to give your name for now. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was at a four-way intersection in Houston, Texas. I was going straight through on the main road when a car coming from the side street turned into my lane.
Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?
A: The passenger side of my car. The other driver hit me right behind the front door.
Q: Did you have a green light?
A: I did. The signal had been green for a while, and I was already moving through the intersection when they came across.
Q: Were you able to brake or swerve before impact?
A: I tried to brake, but there wasn't enough time. I grabbed the steering wheel and braced myself.
Q: Did you hit anything else, or did your airbags deploy?
A: The side curtain airbag came out, and my car spun a little before stopping against the curb.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My left wrist hit the door frame and the doctor at the emergency room said it's fractured. I'm wearing a splint now and I have a follow-up with an orthopedist next week.
Q: Did you receive medical treatment at the scene?
A: Paramedics checked me out there, and then I was taken by ambulance to the hospital for X-rays.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Only that I've been told the other driver was looking at their phone. I didn't see it myself, but a witness said so.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
